18 october 2026 twenty ninth sunday of ordinary time, mission sunday, year a. sunday gospel this year’s theme, chosen by pope leo, is ‘one in christ, united in mission.’ being ‘one in christ’ calls us to keep our lord at the centre of our lives and communities, and our mission is lived by witnessing to god’s love through our words and deeds. in his message for world mission sunday, pope leo xiv shared: ‘your prayers and practical support, particularly on world mission sunday, will be a great help in bringing the gospel of gods love to everyone, especially the poorest and those most in need. every gift, no matter how small, becomes a meaningful act of missionary communion.’ this year’s celebration encourages every catholic in the world to bring to life the mission given to them through baptism — to share the love of god with everyone, everywhere — by supporting missionaries who live alongside and serve communities in greatest need, wherever they are. missionaries’ work is rooted in peace, dignity and hope, and offers help to everyone, regardless of their background or belief.
